Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

ProgramBench: Can Language Models Rebuild Programs From Scratch? · documents: ProgramBench construction uses mini-SWE-agent with Claude Sonnet 4.5 inside Ubuntu 22.04 containers to build reference executables, generate behavioral tests and remove implementation details for inference.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.programbench.agent-construction

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The test-generation agent can inspect original source, documentation and existing tests, unlike the reconstruction task worker.
  • The author did not run this construction pipeline or infer a contracted human annotation workforce from repository contributors or author affiliations.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

ProgramBench: Can Language Models Rebuild Programs From Scratch? · documents: The paper evaluates nine models with a single mini-SWE-agent scaffold, specifying 20 CPUs, 60 GB RAM, a 1,000-step limit and six hours per run.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.programbench.baseline-configuration

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • Appendix B specifies three-minute per-action timeouts, no inference cost cap and prompt caching for reported costs.
  • The author did not execute models, validate runtime equivalence across providers or present historical reported costs as current prices.

ProgramBench: Can Language Models Rebuild Programs From Scratch? · documents: In its internet-access ablation, ProgramBench uses nine model judges from three model families to classify source lookup or binary wrapping, flagging a task when at least five judges identify a violation.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.programbench.judge-ablation-scope

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The paper reports disagreement over dependency caches and API documentation and treats reliable detection as unresolved.
  • Model-panel labels are retained as the authors' ablation method, without inferring independently established human ground truth.
